hook: A *5-Minute* Stretch Can Reset Your Whole Body
dek: 12 yoga-inspired moves to ease tight joints and a stiff back, no gym needed.

slides.label: What happened
slides.text: Triathlete published a 12-move, *5-minute* yoga-inspired routine to melt stiffness fast.

slides.label: Who it's for
slides.text: Perfect for a workday break, a pre-desk reset, or winding down before bed.

slides.label: What you need
slides.text: All you need is a *yoga mat* and a sturdy surface, nothing else required.

slides.label: Moves 1-3
slides.text: Starts with a Full-Body Stretch, Bridge Pose, and Windshield Wipers to loosen hips and spine.

slides.label: Moves 4-6
slides.text: Continues with Wind-Relieving Pose, Seated Shoulder Rolls, and Seated Cat-Cow for upper body tension.

slides.label: Moves 7-9
slides.text: Adds a Seated Spinal Twist, hand opening and closing, and Reverse Tabletop to open the chest and wrists.

slides.label: Final moves
slides.text: Finishes with Bound Angle Pose, Half Plow Pose, and a closing *Savasana* to fully relax.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.text: Five minutes of real movement is maintenance, not a luxury, for anyone grinding through long shifts or building something of their own.

question: Would you actually do this during your workday? Yes or no.
first_comment: Fun fact: the whole routine ends in Savasana, basically a forced 5-minute nap for your nervous system.

caption_instagram:
A 5-minute stretch routine from Triathlete is going viral for fixing tight joints and a stiff back without any equipment, just a yoga mat and a sturdy surface.

The sequence moves through 12 yoga-inspired poses, from Bridge Pose and Windshield Wipers to Seated Cat-Cow, a Spinal Twist and a closing Savasana. Each move pairs breath with movement so tension releases instead of building up, perfect for a desk break, a pre-workday reset or winding down at night.

For anyone working long shifts, multiple jobs or hunched over a laptop building their own thing, five minutes of real movement is not a luxury, it is maintenance.

caption_linkedin:
Triathlete published a 5-minute stretch routine built for anyone who sits too long and moves too little, which is most of us running a business, a side hustle or both.

The sequence is 12 yoga-inspired poses, from a Full-Body Stretch and Bridge Pose through Seated Cat-Cow, a Spinal Twist and a closing Savasana. No equipment beyond a mat. No studio. No forty-five minute time block you do not have.

What stands out is the design: it works as a mid-shift reset, a pre-work grounding moment, or a way to wind down after a long day of calls. For founders and operators who treat rest as something to earn later, this is a reminder that five minutes of real movement protects the body you are running your business from.

Would you build five minutes like this into your workday? Yes or no.

#Wellness #Productivity #Founders

Source: Triathlete https://www.triathlete.com/training/stretches-tight-back-joints/
